calls.title: Hubspot Training: MEDDICC + Pipeline Type
calls.summary: The team reviewed the development of a new sales pipeline architecture in HubSpot, which includes separate pipelines for new business, expansions, and renewals. Jeff Ignacio highlighted the importance of cleaning three years of historical deal data and establishing lead scoring to enhance lead quality. The discussion included forecasting processes led by Ryan McGurk and the integration of sales tools to standardize operations. The team also debated revenue recognition models, emphasizing the need for separate opportunities for expansions and renewals to improve reporting clarity. The MEDPIC framework was discussed for deal qualification, with suggestions for simplification. Finally, there was a plan to centralize sales documentation in Notion for better team access and onboarding support.
calls.keywords: HubSpot, MEDDICC, Pipeline Management, Expansion Revenue, Renewal Process, Sales Enablement

calls.title: Hubspot Training: Managing Deal ACV and TCV
calls.summary: The session focused on streamlining sales expansions and renewals management within the sales pipeline. Key updates included managing expansions either within renewal opportunities or as separate mid-term opportunities, automating calculations for ARR and invoice values to reduce manual errors, and clarifying the distinction between new ARR and expansion ARR. A shift to a 'new plus expansion' forecast view was emphasized for improved visibility on revenue growth. Training was led by Jeff Ignacio, highlighting the importance of these updates for accurate forecasting and team alignment. Participants confirmed understanding of the new processes, which aim to enhance precision in forecasting and align with team submissions.
calls.keywords: expansion, renewal, ARR, forecasting, sales pipeline, incremental ARR
